ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Sweetin uses the camera to take the photo for your sweet and to scan a friend's QR code.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Sweetin opens your photos when you pick an image for your sweet or your profile photo.
ios.NSContactsUsageDescription: Sweetin compares encrypted fingerprints of your contacts' numbers to show you who is already on Sweetin. Nothing is stored.
ios.NSUserNotificationsUsageDescription: Sweetin sends you notifications for the Sweet Hour and your friends' sweets.
